needs.title: What are your needs?
needs.subtitle: We accompany you at every step of your integration in Quebec
needs.instruction: Sélectionnez un service pour en savoir plus

welcome.title: Welcome & Integration
welcome.description: Information, orientation and personalized support to facilitate your settlement.
welcome.fullDescription: Akonpayman endividyèl ak aktivite an gwoup pou fasilite enstalasyon w epi entegrasyon w nan nouvo kominote w la. Nou ede w vin endepandan epi reyisi nan Kebèk.
benefits: Aktivite an gwoup pou kreye lyen
welcome.details: Sèvis gratis an fransè, anglè, panyòl, arab ak lòt lang. Randevou an pèsòn oswa pa telefòn.

french.title: French Learning
french.description: French courses adapted for immigrants, all levels, flexible schedules (8:30 AM-10 PM).
french.fullDescription: Fòmasyon fransè a tan plen ak a tan pasyèl, adapte nan nivo elèv la. Pwofesè kalifye nou yo itilize metòd ansèyman modèn.
benefits: Kou a tan plen ak a tan pasyèl
french.details: Kou gratis finanse pa MIFI. Posibilite alokasyon patisipasyon. Enskripsyon kontini.

employment.title: Employment Assistance
employment.description: CV workshops, interview simulations, professional coaching and meetings with employers.
employment.fullDescription: Apwòch dinamik pou chèche travay, aktivite rezo ak koneksyon avèk anplwayè. Akonpayman pèsonalize pou fasilite entegrasyon w nan mache travay kebekwa a.
benefits: Atelye redaksyon CV ak lèt motivasyon
employment.details: Sèvis gratis ak suivi pèsonalize. Randevou endividyèl ak atelye an gwoup regilyè.

family.title: Family Services
family.description: Support for families, activities for children and teenagers, help with schooling.
family.fullDescription: Sipò pou paran imigran avèk sèvis gadri, oryantasyon eskolè ak aktivite ki ankouraje devlopman global timoun yo ak entegrasyon paran yo.
family.details: Sèvis gratis oswa a pri ba. Plas limite, enskripsyon obligatwa.

women.title: Women of the World
women.description: Specific programs for immigrant women: autonomy, health, employment.
women.fullDescription: Yon espas dedye pou kraze izolman fanm yo atravè koneksyon entèkiltirèl, rezo sipò mityèl ak devlopman konpetans pwofesyonèl pou fanm imigran ak rezidan.
benefits: Atelye otonomi ak estim pwòp tèt ou
women.details: Gratis epi konfidansyèl. Gwoup akeyant ak solidè. Sèvis gadri disponib sou demann.

volunteering.title: Volunteering & Pairing
volunteering.description: Intercultural meetings, social activities and volunteering opportunities.
volunteering.fullDescription: Pwogram jumelaj entèkiltirèl, devlopman konpetans, kou lang ak enfòmatik, pakou entegrasyon sitwayèn ak opòtinite volontarya pou ankouraje apatanans kominote.
volunteering.details: Gratis. Angajman fleksib selon disponibilite w. Sètifika volontarya disponib.

items.name: Asma B.
items.text: Gras a CARI, mwen jwenn travay rèv mwen an 6 mwa! Sipò pèsonalize ak atelye yo ban mwen konfyans pou reyisi nan entèvyou mwen yo.

items.name: Jean-Pierre H.
items.text: Soti nan refijye rive nan antreprenè, CARI akonpanye m nan chak etap. Jodi a mwen gen pwòp biznis mwen epi mwen anplwaye 5 moun.

items.name: Jasmine M.
items.text: Fransè a te sanble enposib, kounye a mwen pale l byen! Kou yo ekselan e pwofesè yo trè pasyan.

items.name: Karla A.
items.text: Pitit mwen yo kontan, nou jwenn plas nou isit la. Sèvis familyal CARI a fè tout diferans lan.

items.name: Wei L.
items.text: Èd pou konprann sistèm kebekwa a chanje tout bagay. Kounye a mwen santi m lakay mwen nan Monreyal.

parallaxItems.name: Asma B.

parallaxItems.quote: Kou fransè yo pèmèt mwen vin endepandan rapidman. Mwen rekòmande l pou tout nouvo vini!
